title: Bound on valid component root labels
statement: Let $G$ be a finite unique game with nonempty finite vertex and constraint sets, distinct endpoints for each constraint, and a permutation of the label set $\\{0,\\ldots,q-1\\}$ attached to each constraint. For any connected component, the number of labels at its chosen root that, when transported along the chosen paths from that root, satisfy every constraint in the component is at most $q$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite unique game with finite nonempty vertex and constraint sets
Each constraint carries a permutation of the $q$ labels
